title: Add support for Bedrock API keys
body:
### Description

Amazon Bedrock [just announced](https://aws.amazon.com/about-aws/whats-new/2025/07/amazon-bedrock-api-keys-for-streamlined-development/) support for API Keys as auth method as an alternative to IAM credentials.

This will simplify onboarding and configuration when using the provider.

My team is willing to implement this feature into the AI SDK, if the idea is welcome please assign the issue to me.

### AI SDK Version

All

## Background

<!-- Why was this change necessary? -->
Amazon Bedrock recently launched API keys as an additional authentication option. Bedrock API keys streamline the authentication process so that developers can focus on building rather than configuration. This PR enables Vercel to use Bedrock API keys, while maintaining existing SigV4 authentication.

## Summary

<!-- What did you change? -->

This PR adds API key authentication support to the Amazon Bedrock provider:

- **New `apiKey` parameter** in `AmazonBedrockProviderSettings`
- **Bearer token authentication** with automatic SigV4 fallback when API key is not provided
- **Environment variable support** via `AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK`
- **Authentication precedence logic:** direct API key → environment variable API key → SigV4 fallback
- **Test coverage** with new test lines and fetch function tests
- **Updated documentation** with authentication examples and usage patterns
- **Example file** demonstrating all authentication scenarios

## Verification

I have manually verified this implementation through:

- **Direct API key authentication** - Tested with explicit `apiKey` parameter
- **Environment variable authentication** - Verified AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK detection
- **SigV4 fallback behavior** - Confirmed seamless fallback when no API key provided
- **Error handling** - Tested invalid API key scenarios and proper error propagation
- **Documentation examples** - Verified all code examples execute correctly
- **Test suite execution** - All new tests pass, covering edge cases and authentication flows
